headlines.description: — Aaron Judge hit a go-ahead, two-run homer in the first inning, and the New York Yankees beat the Miami Marlins 8-2 in their home opener Friday for their second 6-1 start in three seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Judge's 2-run homer in 1st inning leads Yankees over Marlins 8-2 in home opener for 6-1 start

events.name: San Diego Padres at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Marcelo Mayer and Willson Contreras both hit home runs as part of a three-run sixth inning and the Boston Red Sox snapped a five-game losing streak with a 5-2 win in their home opener over the San Diego Padres on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marcelo Mayer, Willson Contreras homer, Red Sox snap 5-game losing streak with 5-2 win over Padres

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters capped a two-run 10th inning with an RBI single and the Chicago White Sox beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4 in a wild home opener on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peters' single caps 2-run 10th as White Sox beat Blue Jays 5-4 in home opener

headlines.description: — Tyler Stephenson hit a tiebreaking two-run homer in the ninth inning and the Cincinnati Reds won in their first road game this season, a 5-3 victory to spoil the home opener for the Texas Rangers on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds beat Rangers 5-3 in their 1st road game with 3 homers, the last in the 9th

headlines.description: — Rookie Chase DeLauter had three hits, including a two-run homer in the seventh inning, and drove in three runs as the Cleveland Guardians won their home opener 4-1 against the Chicago Cubs on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Home runs by DeLauter and Arias in 7th inning propel Guardians to 4-1 victory over Cubs

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Tristan Gray hit his first career grand slam to cap a seven-run seventh inning for the Minnesota Twins in a cold and rainy 10-4 home-opener victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday.

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies and Matt Olson opened the ninth inning with back-to-back home runs, sending the Atlanta Braves to a 2-0 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Albies and Olson hit back-to-back homers in 9th to give Braves 2-0 win over Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Lawrence Butler hit a three-run homer and an RBI single, Max Muncy followed Butler's fourth-inning drive with a solo shot after his earlier two-run double, and the Athletics pounded the Houston Astros 11-4 on Friday night for a victorious home opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lawrence Butler hits 3-run homer in the Athletics' 11-4 win over the Astros in home opener

events.name: New York Mets at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Francisco Alvarez homered twice and rookie Nolan McLean retired his first 15 batters as the New York Mets snapped a three-game skid Friday night with a 10-3 rout of the San Francisco Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits 2 homers and Mets bust out at the plate to back McLean in 10-3 blowout of Giants
